menus.subtitle: Small plates, wood-fired pizza and pub classics

menus.served_text: Wed 5:30 to 8:30pm. Thu to Sat, lunch and evening

sections.name: Small Plates
sections.note: Perfect for sharing or starting your meal.

items.name: Gambas Pil Pil
items.description: King prawns cooked in garlic and chilli butter, served with toasted sourdough.

items.name: Halloumi Bites
items.description: Crispy halloumi tossed in hot honey and paprika salt.

items.name: Southern Fried Chicken Goujons
items.description: Tossed in your choice of Buffalo or BBQ sauce.

items.name: Roasted Red Pepper & Hummus
items.description: Smooth hummus topped with roasted red peppers, olive oil and paprika, served with toasted sourdough.

items.name: Albóndigas
items.description: Spanish-style meatballs in homemade tomato sauce, finished with Parmesan.

sections.name: Our Pizzas
sections.note: All our pizzas are hand-stretched and cooked in our wood-fired oven. Gluten-free bases available on request.

items.name: The Matador
items.description: Tomato base and mozzarella, loaded with pepperoni, roast chicken, Italian salami, chorizo and fresh chillies, finished with a drizzle of hot honey.

items.name: Pepperoni
items.description: Classic tomato base and mozzarella, topped with sliced pepperoni.

items.name: Margherita
items.description: Rich tomato sauce, mozzarella, fresh basil and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

items.name: Prosciutto e Funghi
items.description: Classic tomato base, mozzarella, sliced Italian cooked ham and earthy mushrooms.

items.name: Verdura Classica
items.description: Tomato base, mozzarella, roasted peppers, red onion, mushrooms and black olives.

items.name: Pollo e Pesto
items.description: Tomato base, mozzarella, roast chicken breast, aromatic green basil pesto and red onion.

items.name: Gambas al Ajillo
items.description: Garlic and olive oil white base, mozzarella, juicy king prawns, red chilli flakes and fresh parsley.

items.name: Prosciutto e Rucola
items.description: Crispy mozzarella base topped with torn fresh burrata, fine Serrano ham, peppery rocket and extra virgin olive oil.

items.name: Ham, Egg & Chips
items.description: Home-cooked ham, two free-range eggs and chunky chips.

items.name: Beer-Battered Haddock & Chips
items.description: Beer-battered haddock with chunky chips, buttered peas and homemade tartare sauce.

items.name: Pie of the Week
items.description: Chef's pie of the week, ask your server. Served with mash or chunky chips, seasonal veg and gravy.

items.name: Scampi & Chips
items.description: Breaded scampi with chunky chips, buttered peas and homemade tartare sauce.

items.name: The Lion Burger
items.description: Two 3oz British beef patties with chorizo mayo, mozzarella, lettuce and tomato. Served with fries and house slaw.

sections.name: Wood-Fired Ciabatta
sections.note: All toasted in our wood-fired oven and served with skin-on fries.

Posh Fish Finger with Homemade Tartare Sauce
Wood-Fired Garlic Cheesy Bread
items.description: Garlic butter, mozzarella and fresh parsley.

items.name: Sauces
items.description: Chef's House Dip (sweet mustard & garlic mayo), Chipotle Mayo, BBQ Sauce.
